d:
A man confronts teenagers.
Walter is a widower who has retreated into solitude in the wake of his wife's passing. He spends his hours inside, painstakingly working on his miniatures. But his fragile peace is broken when local neighborhood teenagers harass him, egging his house and interrupting his self-imposed exile from the outside world.
At first, Walter bears the harassment stoically enough. But as the teens escalate into bullying the older man, he decides to fight back.
